notes: Two taḥwīl branches; «عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن سالم، عن أبيه» comes after the last «ح» (in branch 2), so it is the shared tail; branch 1's «عن معمر» is the same level
«أبيه» is bare: the saying's «قال ابن عمر فقلت» names Ibn Umar, but «أبيه» is not merged with him (rule 7), so the relation stands and the review should decide
«قال زكريا في حديثه ... وفي حديث بشر» is a version remark, not a route
